stem: New growth develops interveinal chlorosis while total fertilizer EC is already high. Which diagnostic response is strongest?
choices: Check root-zone pH, root health, source-water chemistry, and recent nutrient changes before increasing trace elements
Add a concentrated micronutrient blend immediately
Assume the visual pattern proves iron deficiency
Increase EC further because deficiency symptoms always mean low total fertilizer
rationale: Micronutrient-like symptoms can result from availability, pH, root dysfunction, antagonism, or supply. High total EC makes automatic fertilizer escalation especially weak without additional evidence.
